date_rules: All relative dates use config/generation/base.json:reference_today and never the wall clock.
Overdue means due_date < reference_today AND completed_date IS NULL.
This quarter uses an inclusive quarter start and exclusive next-quarter start.
Completed tasks require completed_date and non-completed tasks require it to be null.
Completed milestones require actual_date and incomplete milestones require it to be null.
Assignment release dates are inclusive and cannot precede assignment dates.
Time entries must fall within their valid assignment windows unless a coordinated boundary scenario adjusts the complete path.
decimal_rules: Stored decimal values use their configured precision and exactly two fractional digits.
All rounding uses ROUND_HALF_UP and calculations round once at the final output scale.
Allocation percentages must be positive and sum exactly to 100.00 per task.
Milestone completion percentage is DECIMAL(5,2) and uses NULLIF for a defensive zero denominator.
Binary floating-point arithmetic is prohibited for contract values.
currency_rules: projects.currency_code and resources.currency_code must equal USD.
Project Management has no FX conversion path.
consistency_rules: Every physical foreign key must reference an existing parent row.
Every time-entry task/resource pair must exist in task_resources.
Every project must have at least one milestone.
Selected projects must remain taskless for the declared LEFT JOIN path.
Every task must have at least one resource assignment.
At least one task must have multiple resources and at least one resource must have multiple tasks.
Task/resource assignment pairs must be unique.
Project, task, assignment, milestone, and time-entry dates must preserve chronology.
Project and task windows must include deliberately overlapping ranges.
Only time_entries may gain rows during imperfection injection.
Controlled NULL and outlier targets must modify only approved eligible rows.
